shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved on a monolithic upright block
arms rendered in low relief held against the sides of the torso
forearms bent inward across the front of the body
hand with fingers indicated as parallel incised grooves
hands/arms converging at the centre of the abdomen
schematic, near-flat treatment of the body surface
justification: Both show a columnar anthropomorphic figure whose arms are carved in shallow relief close to the body, bending forward so that the hands, with fingers rendered as a set of parallel grooves, meet across the front of the belly \u2014 a fairly specific and conventional scheme rather than a generic standing figure. The chief differences in content are that A presents an unadorned torso with an emphatic head and facial features while B's figure grasps a distinct projecting cylindrical object and carries further incised detailing above the arm, and no head is visible.
